svg.title: The Supreme Court leaves UC research grant rulings in place
svg.desc: Editorial illustration: a low-angle view up the marble steps and Corinthian columns of the U.S. Supreme Court against a deep green evening sky. Gold light streams from the central bay down across the picture into a university research lab, where researchers in lab coats work at a microscope and hold up a flask beneath a window showing a campus clock tower, while blank sheets of paper drift along the beam. It represents the Court declining, on Nov. 16, 2026, the Trump administration's appeal over cancelled University of California research grants.
